a2_geometry.source_basis: The G-VFA group is visibly struck through. The separate ---DD group is also excluded in this conditional readable 252-slot model; that exclusion is not asserted to be uniquely compelled by typography. Both remain in the literal source.
a2_geometry.screen_scope: Only the five boundaries in the visible four-character DVAX group, with the two stated five-coordinate exclusions held fixed. Text and geometry were selected after the earlier candidates were seen; this is not a blind control or a global geometry exclusion.
